_instructions: TEMPLATE ONLY: documentation IPs and zero pose below are not a field calibration.
Create a separate runtime file for each vehicle and charger; do not commit field profiles.
A technician must confirm hardware identity, exact current map binding, reflector-to-contact offset, insertion and exit travel before commissioning.
Navigation must reach approachSite with approachPose heading already facing the calibrated docking axis. The worker will not blindly turn a vehicle near the plug.
All distances/speeds below are software examples, not physical permission. Preserve obstacle protection. If it prevents insertion, confirm the manufacturer's near-field docking strategy.
approachPose is the mapped safe entry/undock pose, not the inserted dock pose. Actual return station, pose, stop and charging state are checked before road navigation.
Undock segments must be individually calibrated, axial and <=0.30 m each; total <=1.20 m. Never copy another vehicle's distances or historical world dock coordinates.
